text:
sanjay: quick follow-up from the postmortem doc — repeating vendor auth spikes are turning into a pattern. want a tight remediation plan + a recurrence check schedule.

ops-bot: INCIDENT-2026-513 created by sanjay  severity: degraded.

elaine: agree. can we break into short/medium/long actions and owners? also add a monthly review slot in tracker.

ken: short: add randomized jitter to token refresh and cap concurrent refreshes per process. feature flag for 48h. owner: ken. due: +2d.

ash: medium: routing safety gates — per-region spill thresholds + automatic warmup. owner: ash. due: +6d.

maria: monitoring: synthetic that runs token refresh + model pull every 4m, with an alert after 2 failures. also dashboard to trend vendor-induced 4xx/5xx. owner: maria. due: +3d.

tim: vendor liaison: schedule vendor RCA, request signer telemetry and a written throttle policy (429 semantics). owner: tim. vendor call: Fri 1500 UTC.

vishal: long-term: add client-side circuit-breaker and a configurable cache with TTL tied to vendor rotation window. owner: vishal. due: +21d.

acme-sre: we see correlated signer autoscaler churn during bursts. we'll share logs and a proposed patch before the Fri call.

ops-bot: Reminder  tag incident: vendor:acme, subsystem:auth, recurrence:monthly.

sanjay: consolidated action list in doc: A1: jitter + capped refresh (ken)  DUE +2d; A2: synthetic + dashboard + pager (maria)  DUE +3d; A3: routing spill + warmup (ash)  DUE +6d; A4: vendor SLA writeup + RCA call (tim)  DUE Fri; A5: circuit-breaker + cache plan (vishal)  DUE +21d; A6: add monthly recurrence in tracker (sanjay)  DUE +1d.

ken: PRs I plan to open: refresh-backoff #4510, refresh-cap #4511. will mark A1/A2 in PRs.

maria: synthetic harness will include simulated 429/401s and surface a regression metric to the ops dashboard. will hand pager links to eng-oncall.

ash: routing plan will include canary steps and an automatic rollback if error rates increase > 1.5x.

tim: vendor call agenda posted in doc. please add any additional asks (rate tables, notification hooks).

elaine: i'll create the calendar invite for the Fri call and the monthly recurrence for the tracker.

acme-sre: we'll provide signer telemetry and timeline before the call. we'll also propose a safer default autoscaler config.

sanjay: checkpoints: Wed internal check, Fri vendor call, next Tue closure review. i'll log these in the mitigation tracker and ping owners for daily updates.

vishal: I'll draft the circuit-breaker proposal and include experiments for safe defaults.

ops-bot: Note  add labels: postmortem-followup, owner-tracker, vendor-acme.

ken: opened PR #4510 for backoff helpers. requesting reviews from @maria and @vishal.

maria: quick review on #4510 done — left small nit. synthetic deployed to staging.

sanjay: thanks everyone. I'll update the tracker tonight and assign the monthly recurrence. If an owner wants to reprioritize, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
